image_description: A close-up portrait of a Muscovy duck (Cairina moschata) head and neck. The bird has white plumage, prominent red caruncles (fleshy growths) around the eyes and base of the bill, and a pale pinkish bill that is open. The eye is light-colored with a dark pupil. A watermark 'Naturesbyte' is visible in the bottom right corner.
